guide.intro: Here is everything you can do with PlantPal.

add.title: Add your plants
add.body: Give each plant a name, say how often it needs water, and add a photo from your camera or gallery.

ai.title: Identify with AI
ai.body: Not sure what plant it is? Take a photo and tap "Identify with AI" for a suggested name and watering interval. Always check it before saving.

water.title: Water with one tap
water.body: Tap "Water" when you water a plant. The list shows when each one needs water next, and you can undo a tap from its history.

reminders.title: Get reminders
reminders.body: Turn on reminders in Settings and PlantPal tells you the morning a plant is due, plus a daily nudge if one is overdue. Tap a reminder to open that plant.

offline.title: Works without internet
offline.body: Everything works offline. Your changes are saved on the phone and sync on their own when you are back online; the badge at the top shows the status.

devices.title: Same plants on every device
devices.body: Sign in on another phone and your plants, waterings and photos are there. Changes on one phone appear on the others.

photos.title: Photo history
photos.body: See how a plant grows with a photo timeline. Free accounts keep one photo per plant.

premium.title: Premium
premium.body: The free plan includes {{plants}} plants and {{aiFree}} AI identifications a day. Premium unlocks unlimited plants, photo history and {{aiPremium}} AI identifications a day. Already subscribed on another phone? Use "Restore purchases".

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Sign out at any time, or delete your account and all its data from Settings. Signing out also clears your plants from this phone.

settings.analyticsNote: Counts such as "a plant was added" help improve PlantPal. Never plant names, photos or your email. No ads, no tracking across apps.
